categories.main_business_segments: Puruisi is a clinical research service provider specializing in Site Management Organization (SMO) services. The company provides comprehensive clinical trial execution services including pre-trial planning, site activation, on-site execution, and full-process project management. The company also offers related services such as functional service provider (FSP) services, patient recruitment, and data management services to pharmaceutical companies, medical device companies, and Contract Research Organizations (CROs).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed a standardized project management system based on Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and ICH-GCP guidelines, comprising over 270 Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Core technologies include a proprietary ERP system for integrated management, a big data modeling platform for clinical trial strategy optimization, and an electronic data capture system for clinical research. The company utilizes advanced information technology for quality management, risk control, and operational efficiency improvement in clinical trial execution.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include international and domestic pharmaceutical companies, medical device companies, and Contract Research Organizations (CROs). The company serves major global pharmaceutical companies including Merck, Roche, Johnson & Johnson, Novartis, Bristol Myers Squibb, Eli Lilly, and Bayer. The company focuses on innovative drug development projects across multiple therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiovascular disease, endocrine disease, infectious disease, and rare diseases.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with service coverage across nearly 190 cities nationwide. The company has established regional offices and service capabilities in major pharmaceutical research centers. International operations are minimal, representing only 0.38% of 2023 revenue. The company serves over 900 clinical trial institutions with the capability to cover more than 1,300 institutions across China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the pharmaceutical research and development supply chain, specifically in the clinical trial execution phase. The company provides outsourced services to pharmaceutical companies and CROs who are responsible for drug development and regulatory approval. The company is positioned between drug developers (upstream) and regulatory authorities (downstream), facilitating the clinical trial process.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes: (1) building and perfecting training and management systems to enhance core service capabilities; (2) expanding clinical trial site coverage in depth and breadth; (3) constructing a comprehensive big data platform integrating operational and project data management; (4) developing digital solutions for clinical trial execution efficiency; (5) strengthening capabilities in innovative drug categories including CAR-T, ADC, bispecific antibodies, and PD-1/PD-L1 therapies; (6) enhancing quality management systems to meet increasingly stringent regulatory requirements.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through service fees for clinical trial site management services. Revenue is recognized based on two main models: (1) Fee-For-Service (FFS) model where revenue is recognized upon delivery of specific services or milestones; (2) Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) model where revenue is recognized monthly based on assigned personnel and fixed hourly rates. The company also generates revenue from related services including patient recruitment, data management, and functional service provider (FSP) services. Revenue is recognized as performance obligations are satisfied over time or at specific points in time.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading SMO service provider in China with significant competitive advantages. Major competitors include other SMO companies and CRO firms with SMO capabilities such as Parexel and Syneos Health. The company differentiates itself through: (1) extensive experience with over 3,000 completed clinical projects; (2) strong relationships with major global pharmaceutical companies; (3) comprehensive geographic coverage across China; (4) advanced technology platforms and standardized management systems; (5) specialized expertise in innovative drug categories. The company has participated in bringing over 140 products to market and maintains high service quality standards recognized by international pharmaceutical companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized pharmaceutical services company with strong growth trajectory. 2023 revenue reached 760.04 million yuan, representing 29.65% year-over-year growth from 586.23 million yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 134.73 million yuan in 2023, up 86.06% from 72.41 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 1.37 billion yuan at year-end 2023, up 17.76% from 1.16 billion yuan in 2022. The company demonstrates strong profitability with net profit margins improving to 17.73% in 2023 from 12.35% in 2022, indicating operational leverage and efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on: (1) comprehensive full-process clinical trial management from planning through execution, reducing client burden and improving efficiency; (2) advanced data-driven approach utilizing big data modeling and analytics to optimize trial site selection, patient recruitment, and resource allocation; (3) extensive clinical trial institution network covering 1,300+ sites across 190 cities, enabling rapid site activation; (4) specialized expertise in innovative drug categories including oncology, immunotherapy, and rare diseases; (5) stringent quality management systems exceeding international standards, ensuring data integrity and regulatory compliance; (6) experienced professional team with deep pharmaceutical industry knowledge; (7) proven track record of supporting successful drug launches and regulatory approvals.
